handoff.salientSummary: Implemented GET /api/v1/evaluations/:id/status endpoint returning status (pending/running/completed/failed/cancelled) and progress (0-100). Endpoint includes error field for failed tasks and cancelled_at for cancelled tasks. All 9 test cases pass covering valid ID, all status states, not found (404), and invalid UUID (400).
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Implemented GET /api/v1/evaluations/:id/status handler with GetEvaluationStatusResponse struct containing id, status, progress, error (for failed), and cancelled_at (for cancelled). Routes registered in main.go. Unit tests cover all expected behaviors from validation contract.
